title: 第九章 门上的方程第十章 凛冬和她的三千年
lines: 章节摘要：“你们把知识变成了神迹，把神迹变成了统治。但有人，把答案藏在了一扇门里。“——牛顿
宁修远是在废土东区边缘，第一次看见净化阵的效果的。
那是一条狗。
废土里的流浪狗，不少见，骨架嶙峋，皮毛脏，但活得很有韧性。这条狗不知道什么时候越过了警戒线，走进了净化阵的覆盖边缘——宁修远看见它的时候，它已经躺在地上，四肢还在动，但动得不对，不是挣扎，是某种更深层的抽搐，像是内部的什么东西在被慢慢抹掉。
皮毛还在。
骨架还在。
但眼睛里的光，正在以一种宁修远说不清楚的速度，消失。
他在原地站了五秒，然后转过身，没有再看。
牛顿没有说话。
叶清欢站在他旁边，眼睛一直是开着的。她的300%感知接收到了某种宁修远感知不到的信号，因为她的手指在微微收紧，却没有开口解释那是什么。
宁修远往回走，声音很平：
“三天。“
“我们去看秦墨说的那个地方。“
破晓的作战室里，秦墨把数字摆在桌上。
反抗军现在能作战的成员：一百九十三人。
天道院在废土部署的执法修士：超过一千人，其中金丹期以上，三十七人。
净化阵：已完成外围布置，正在向中心区域推进，每小时覆盖半径扩大约两公里。
三天后，覆盖废土全域。
“我们打不过。“秦墨说，他没有犹豫，直接说结论，“正面硬刚，一个小时之内全灭。“
“但是，“他停了一下，“如果能激活遗迹里的武库……“
“你们找了多久？“宁修远问。
“三年。“秦墨看着他，“发现遗迹，两年半。打不开门，半年。“
“之前两个持有者，都试过了？“
“都试过。“
“那为什么你觉得我行？“
秦墨没有立刻回答，只是看了一眼宁修远胸口，那里，金色印记隐在衣物下，不可见，但秦墨显然知道它在哪里。
“因为之前两个持有者，没有走到能用上武库的那一天。“他说，“他们在路上就死了。“
“而你，“他顿了一下，“还活着。“
宁修远沉默了三秒，站起来：
“带我去。“
遗迹的入口，藏在废土地下十七层。
下去的路不好走——不是设计上的困难，是时间的问题，升降梯的钢缆已经断了三根，剩下的一根在他们下降的时候发出一种令人不安的**，宁修远盯着那根钢缆，牛顿在他脑海里安静地算了一下剩余拉力，最后说了一个字：
叶清欢把宁修远放在她右侧，用机械触须额外固定了一下，没有解释，宁修远也没有问。
十七层，大约四十米。
下降过程里，气温在变化，不是变冷，而是变成一种奇怪的、几乎像新鲜的温度——宁修远在废土生活了二十年，从没闻到过这样的空气，没有机油，没有辐射的金属味，就是干净的，带着某种非常古老的静。
叶清欢轻声说：“空气里有纳米级别的保护层。“
“多久了？“
她扫描了一下，停顿：“……大约三千年。“
升降梯落地，打开。
眼前是一条走廊，走廊尽头，是门。
宁修远在距离那扇门还有十米的地方，停下来。
content_en:
Chapter summary: "You turned knowledge into miracles, and miracles into domination. But someone hid the answer in a door." - Newton
Ning Xiuyuan saw the effect of the purification array for the first time at the edge of the Eastern Wasteland.
That's a dog.
There are many stray dogs in the wasteland. They have jagged skeletons and dirty fur, but they live very resiliently. The dog didn't know when it crossed the cordon and walked into the edge of the purification array - when Ning Xiuyuan saw it, it was already lying on the ground, its limbs were still moving, but the movement was wrong. It wasn't a struggle, but some kind of deeper twitching, as if something inside was slowly being erased.
The fur is still there.
The skeleton is still there.
But the light in his eyes was disappearing at a speed that Ning Xiuyuan couldn't explain.
He stood there for five seconds, then turned around without looking again.
Newton said nothing.
Ye Qinghuan stood next to him, his eyes always open. Her 300% perception received some kind of signal that Ning Xiuyuan could not detect, because her fingers were tightening slightly, but she did not explain what it was.
Ning Xiuyuan walked back and said in a calm voice:
"Three days."
"Let's go see the place Qin Mo mentioned."
In the war room at dawn, Qin Mo put the numbers on the table.
The current combat-ready members of the resistance: one hundred and ninety-three.
The number of law enforcement monks deployed by the Tiandaoyuan in the wasteland: more than a thousand, including thirty-seven at the Golden Core stage and above.
Purification array: The peripheral layout has been completed and is advancing towards the central area, with the coverage radius expanding by about two kilometers per hour.
Three days later, the entire wasteland will be covered.
"We can't defeat them." Qin Mo said. He did not hesitate and said the conclusion directly, "Fight them head-on, and we will destroy them all within an hour."
"But," he paused, "if we can activate the arsenal in the ruins..."
"How long have you been looking for?" Ning Xiuyuan asked.
"Three years." Qin Mo looked at him, "Two and a half years since the discovery of the ruins. Half a year since the door couldn't be opened."
"Have you tried it with the two previous holders?"
"Tried them all."
"Then why do you think I can do it?"
Qin Mo didn't answer immediately, but just glanced at Ning Xiuyuan's chest. There, the golden mark was hidden under the clothes and was invisible, but Qin Mo obviously knew where it was.
"Because the two previous holders did not reach the day when they could use the arsenal." He said, "They died on the way."
"And you," he paused, "are still alive."
Ning Xiuyuan was silent for three seconds and stood up:
"Take me there."
The entrance to the ruins is hidden seventeen levels underground in the wasteland.
The way down was not easy - it was not a design difficulty, but a matter of time. Three of the elevator's steel cables had been broken, and the remaining one made an unsettling sound when they descended. Ning Xiu stared at the steel cable from afar, and Newton quietly calculated the remaining tension in his mind, and finally said one word:
"Enough."
Ye Qinghuan placed Ning Xiuyuan on her right side and fixed it with mechanical tentacles. There was no explanation and Ning Xiuyuan did not ask.
Seventeenth floor, about forty meters.
During the descent, the temperature was changing, not getting colder, but becoming a strange, almost fresh temperature - Ning Xiuyuan had lived in the wasteland for twenty years, and had never smelled such air. There was no engine oil, no metallic smell of radiation, it was just clean, with a very ancient tranquility.
Ye Qinghuan said softly: "There is a nano-level protective layer in the air."
"How long?"
She scanned it and paused: "...about three thousand years."
The elevator landed and opened.
In front of you is a corridor, and at the end of the corridor is a door.
Ning Xiuyuan stopped ten meters away from the door.
title_en: Chapter 9 The Equation on the Door Chapter 10 Winter and Her Three Thousand Years
